digest.component_or_area: Jira DC capability verification and hardening
propositions: The capability-map workflow reports incorrect contract state silently instead of failing when Epic-field ids cannot be verified after agent run
Capability call sites are cast but not runtime-guarded, causing non-capable transports to fail silently rather than loudly
The readiness rule from 9790 was not applied to the third live-DC channel workflow gate
The dormant absence-probe port and its dependencies need disposition decision with impact analysis on both-backends acceptance criteria
Capability map validation must distinguish between missing Epic fields and absent Software projects, failing the job when contract cannot be established
Live DC harness must remain green end-to-end after hardening changes without skipping or xfailing cells
